Whitelist/sale gate that queries pairFor and condition before allowing a transfer.
Validates sale count and min/max sale bounds; reverts indirectly by returning false.
Owner-restricted arbitrary delegatecall into attacker-supplied address and calldata.

Owner-only configuration of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against _from and used as the allowance spender key inside transferFrom.
transferFrom requires msg.sender != _from, and delegate gates the arbitrary delegatecall via require(msg.sender == owner).
_mints authorizes msg.sender against owner or a hardcoded address before minting and whitelisting.
init requires msg.sender == owner before rewriting sale configuration.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner and debits balanceOf[msg.sender].
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before updating the whitelist.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] using the caller address.
owner state variable is the sole gate protecting the delegatecall entrypoint.
owner state variable authorizes _mints alongside the hardcoded address.
owner state variable authorizes init configuration.
owner state variable authorizes batchSend.
owner state variable authorizes setTradeAddress.
delegate performs a low-level delegatecall to attacker-controlled address a with payload b, executing in this contract's storage context.
transfer forwards control to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom invokes ensure(_from, _to, _value) as its sale/whitelist gate.
ensure falls through to condition(_from, _value) for min/max sale validation.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair address compared against _from.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value are unchecked subtractions in transferFrom.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
transferFrom._value flows directly into the unchecked balance and allowance subtractions.
batchSend._value is a multiplication operand in the unchecked total computation.
batchSend._tos length scales the unchecked total computation.
Overflow-prone product is stored in the local total used for the balance check and debit.
delegate.b calldata is passed straight into the delegatecall payload.
delegate.a is used as the delegatecall target address.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] without SafeMath.
transferFrom debits balanceOf[_from] and credits balanceOf[_to].
batchSend debits balanceOf[msg.sender] and credits each recipient's balanceOf.
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] with the scaled mint amount.
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true, granting whitelist bypass of ensure.
init writes the scaled minimum sale value into _minSale.
init writes the scaled maximum sale value into _maxSale.
init writes the sale count limit into _saleNum.
setTradeAddress assigns addr to the tradeAddress whitelist slot.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
approve writes the new value into allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] outside SafeMath on every successful transfer.
